name: Silero VAD
description: Local voice activity detection. Runs on CPU with no API key.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Minimum speech probability for an audio frame to count as speech.

start_secs.title: Start delay (s)
start_secs.description: How long speech must last before the user counts as speaking.

stop_secs.title: Stop delay (s)
stop_secs.description: How long silence must last before the user counts as stopped. Turn-end detection runs on top of this, so keep it short.

min_volume.title: Minimum volume
min_volume.description: Audio quieter than this is never treated as speech.
